findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 47 requests to 12 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 3.8 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 1.2 MB (32%) came from third-party domains, 711 kB of it from services classified as tracking (17 requests).

8 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), facebook.com (Meta, social), facebook.net (Meta, social), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), imasdk.googleapis.com (Google, advertising), mrf.io (Marfeel, analytics), newsroom.bi (Marfeel, analytics).
5 cookies were set by third-party domains (31 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 8 requests were blocked. The page still made 47 requests to 12 third-party domains, including 8 tracking services in our list.
